constraints.description: The approved Claude Design prototype is the source of truth for layout, copy, and motion. Reference copy lives in .ba/discovery/design-reference/ ('Mobeeli Landing.dc.html', 'Join Waitlist.dc.html', fitment-3d.js, indo-globe.js, parts-gen.html, tokens/brand notes in design-project-memory.md). The built site must match it section-for-section: sticky nav, dark hero with 3D fitment-wheel scene + floating cards, proof bar, problem tiles + Senen quote, how-it-works + comparison, buyer strip, Why Mobeeli band, AI catalog showcase card with orbiting part sprites, Early Adaptors cards + waitlist CTA, team, investors, Indonesia flyover-map band, dark footer.

Plus Jakarta Sans (self-hosted); blue palette: primary #2f7df6, hover #5596f7, deep #1b5fd9/#123f9e, light accent #5b9bf7, tint #e4edfd, ink #0d1522, bg #f5f7fa, borders #e3e7ee; red #b91c1c only for pain stats; light theme with dark hero + dark footer; pill buttons; 18px card radii.

Copy rules from the design review: NEVER state Mobeeli's exact fee (use 'one low, flat rate'); never name Tokopedia/Shopee ('generalist marketplace'); 'Early Adaptors' spelling is intentional; no hype language, no emoji; investor copy never says 'raising'; footer is 'Mobeeli — Jakarta, Indonesia' with no legal entity name; canon numbers are the brief set ($5.3B, 9 of 14, 120M+, 19.4%, 86%, 16.75–19.66%, 0% first 300, 100,000+ workshops) with an optional 'deck' variant (38 of 60, 190K+).

Full-site EN/ID toggle is mandatory on both pages; ID copy uses the naturalized casual-professional tone already written in the design (TXT maps) with EN loanwords kept ('Join Waitlist', 'Founders', 'Launching'); language choice persists (localStorage 'mobeeli-lang'); hero H1 rotates four phrase pairs per language.

Deploy target is the empty GitHub repo https://github.com/piztanza/mobeeli-landing-page.git (wired at ba_project_bootstrap). The design's DC runtime (support.js/DCLogic, x-import, image-slot) must be re-implemented natively — the two 3D custom elements (fitment-wheel, indo-globe; three.js) port nearly as-is. reduced-motion support required. The waitlist wizard currently has no backend: 'submit' only shows a success panel + WhatsApp deep link — the real site needs actual lead persistence (form backend/database or at minimum email/WhatsApp handoff), to be decided at strategy phase.

Transferable assets already copied to .ba/discovery/design-reference/ (part sprites disc/filter/plug/shock/air, file-type icons, latin woff2 fonts). NOT transferred (must be supplied by the user or regenerated): mobeeli logo PNGs (blue/white/full + mark), unify-graph.mp4 hero video, veo-poster.jpg, parts/pad.png (regenerate via parts-gen.html). Open items from design: real waitlist URL, founder headshots, Yavet's LinkedIn URL.

Pre-launch site — needed ahead of the 2026 Jakarta launch and while the May 2026 incumbent fee hikes are still fresh; the Early Adaptor field campaign is already running, so sooner is materially better.
